authorization: 用户要求：修复 P4 隐私闸门在顾问回放中暴露的两个漏洞，量级提示暂不做；修复后推送到 P4 所在分支。
scope_vs_P4: Worker text no longer makes pieces of result ids public: a prefix or suffix (5+ characters) of an id seen in a result stays data when the worker writes it, e.g. an id tail it filtered on or quoted in a question.
JSON keys that mix digits with capitals (record ids used as keys, e.g. ka0Wt000000Eo6cIAC) are data, not schema field names.
unchanged_vs_P4: middleware, prompts, trigger, config and the privacy switch (advisor_mode.privacy.enabled, default off)
with privacy off, advisor input is identical to P4
found_by: Offline advice replay of the 15 P3 DAB consults through the P4 middleware: 29 result-id tokens in 4 of the 15 privacy-on requests were left unmasked.
threat_model: accidental leakage only (honest worker, curious advisor)
known_privacy_gaps: values written in another form (2020-11 vs November) are not matched
values shorter than 4 characters that are not all caps are not indexed
integers up to 10 are not masked
lowercase single-word dictionary keys (e.g. category values used as keys) are still read as field names
masked numbers carry no magnitude (decided: not addressed in P4.1)
intended_arms: P4.1 privacy off (= P3 + DAB failure detection)
change_policy: Preserve P4.1; freeze subsequent implementation changes under a new version.
